content.text: {"core": "Breakthrough removes what has stopped holding. In Creation — the threshold where built structure becomes outward form — it acts on the final wall before something crosses over. Unnamed here, the breaking goes unworked and the structure stays, blocking the exit. What is ready to leave cannot leave because the door still reads as load-bearing.", "sheetLine": "The last wall before the crossing is the one that won't come down."}
